title: Service Advisor
description:
Role - Service Advisor / Service Receptionist

Location - Chester

Salary - £30,000 Basic Salary £38,000 Realistic OTE Overtime Available

1 in 4 Saturday Mornings

Richard Abson Group is delighted to be assisting a prestigious automotive dealership in Chester in their search for an experienced Service Advisor / Service Receptionist.

Representing one of the industry's leading premium brands, this dealership forms part of a highly respected dealer group renowned for investing in its people. You'll benefit from ongoing manufacturer training, genuine career progression, and the opportunity to work within a modern, forward-thinking business embracing the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology.

As the first point of contact for customers, you'll play a key role in delivering an exceptional aftersales experience. You'll manage service bookings, provide vehicle progress updates, explain technical information in a customer-friendly manner, and identify opportunities to promote service plans and additional aftersales products.

Working Hours:
- Monday to Friday, 8am-6pm
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime

What we're looking for:
- Minimum of 1 year's experience as a Service Advisor or in a similar aftersales role within a franchised main dealership
- A passion for delivering outstanding customer service with a proactive sales approach
- Experience using Kerridge and 1 Link would be advantageous, although not essential
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- A professional and customer-focused approach

Salary & Benefits:
- £30,000 basic salary
- £38,000 realistic OTE
- Uncapped bonus opportunities, including hours sold, service plans and upsell/cross-sell performance
- Current team members are consistently exceeding their bonus targets
- 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, paid at overtime
- Manufacturer training and genuine career progression
- Opportunity to work with the latest hybrid and electric vehicle technology

If you're an experienced Service Advisor or Service Receptionist looking to join a premium main dealership that genuinely invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Part Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Payroll Assistant

Location: Northwich
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Hours: 15 or 22.5 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days

We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Payroll Assistant to join an established and growing professional services business in Northwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who already has some payroll experience and is looking to broaden their knowledge, take on more responsibility and develop their career within payroll. You'll join a supportive and experienced payroll team, with plenty of opportunity to learn and develop your skills across a varied client base.

The Role

Working as part of the payroll team, you will assist with the accurate and timely processing of payrolls for a diverse portfolio of clients. This will include weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies across a range of sectors.

You will work closely with experienced payroll professionals, giving you the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, gain exposure to different payroll requirements and build your confidence in dealing with clients and payroll queries.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the preparation and processing of payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Process payroll information accurately and ensure deadlines are met.
- Support with payroll administration, including Auto Enrolment and BACS processing.
- Respond to routine payroll queries from clients, colleagues, HMRC and other third parties.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records.
- Assist with resolving payroll issues and escalate more complex queries when required.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
- Build strong and professional relationships with clients.
- Work collaboratively with the wider payroll team.
- Contribute to improving payroll processes and delivering a high level of client service.

About You

We're looking for someone with some previous payroll experience who is keen to develop and expand their skill set.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working in a payroll role.
- A good understanding of basic payroll processes and statutory requirements.
- Some knowledge of Auto Enrolment and statutory payments.
- Experience using payroll software; BrightPay experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Good communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- A positive attitude and genuine interest in developing a career in payroll.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Experience within a payroll bureau or accountancy practice would be advantageous, but candidates from an in-house payroll background will also be considered.

Why Join?

You'll be joining a supportive team where you can continue to develop your payroll experience while working with a varied client portfolio. The role offers flexibility and could suit someone looking to balance their career with other commitments.

Benefits include:
- 36 days' holiday including Bank Holidays and Christmas period (full-time equivalent)
- 5% employer pension contribution
- Option to buy or sell up to 5 days' holiday
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Life Assurance
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long-service enhancements to pension contributions and holiday entitlement
- On-site parking
- Team social events
- Free fruit

Hours & Flexibility

This is a permanent part-time position, with flexibility around working hours.

Applications are welcomed from candidates looking to work either:
- 15 hours per week over 2 days, or
- 22.5 hours per week over 3 days

This could be an ideal opportunity for an experienced Payroll Assistant looking for a part-time position, or someone with existing payroll experience who is keen

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims on behalf of a number of Public Sector clients.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle a variety of casualty/personal injury claims through to settlement
- Verify policy cover/validity
- Log and record all claims digitally
- Investigate allocated claims either from desk or instructed by the team of loss adjusters
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Make decision on liability and negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience working in the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Sector
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- The ability or understand insurance policy wordings and the insurance market
- Knowledge of civil procedure rules and the claims portal
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on Offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more

title: Sales Support / Import Documentation Controller
description:
Sales Support / Import Documentation Controller

Tarporley, Cheshire
Circa £32,000 Per Annum
Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
Office based, with some hybrid Working Available
Optional Weekend Overtime Available (Paid in Addition)

A fantastic opportunity has arisen to join a well-established and growing business in Tarporley as a Sales Support / Invoicing Import Documentation Controller.

Working within a friendly team of 5-6 people, you'll play a pivotal role in supporting customers, processing orders, managing import documentation and ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of commercial operations.

This is a varied role that combines customer communication, sales administration, order processing and document control. Much of your customer interaction will take place via email and WhatsApp, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships and delivering excellent service without the pressure of a targeted sales environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Acting as a primary point of contact for customers via email, WhatsApp and telephone
- Processing customer orders accurately through a bespoke internal system
- Generating invoices and supporting documentation using Sage
- Preparing, checking and managing import and customs-related documentation
- Ensuring all paperwork is completed accurately and within required timescales
- Providing customers with updates regarding orders, shipments and deliveries
- Liaising with internal teams and external partners to resolve queries
- Maintaining accurate customer, order and shipment records
- Supporting the wider commercial team with administrative duties
- Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates from backgrounds such as:
- Sales Administration
- Customer Service
- Order Processing
- Logistics Administration
- Import / Export Administration
- Commercial Administration
- Account Coordination

You'll also possess:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- A proactive and organised approach to work
- A customer-focused mindset

Experience using Sage would be advantageous but is by no means essential, as training can be provided.

Previous import/export or food industry experience would be beneficial but is not required.

What's On Offer?
- Salary circa £32,000 per annum
- Hybrid working arrangements
- Monday to Friday working hours (9am-5pm)
- Optional paid weekend overtime
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Ongoing training and development
- Stable and successful business
- Genuine examples of internal progression and career development

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and customer-focused individual looking to develop a long-term career within a supportive business where their contribution will make a real impact.

To apply or discuss the opportunity in more detail, please get in touch today.

title: Team Administrator
company: Cheshire and Wirral Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Cheshire and Wirral Partnership NHS Foundation Trust
description: We're seeking a proactive and motivated Band 3 Administrator to support the Specialist Perinatal Mental Health Team across the CWP footprint. This role is vital to smooth service delivery, supporting both staff and service users. You'll provide flexible cover across teams, handling telephony, diary management, audio typing, ordering supplies, managing data both recording and analysing and line management responsibilities. This post is full time and hours will be within the core business hours of the team. The Trust currently supports the Real Living Wage (RLW) hourly rate as set by the Living Wage Federation and will apply a pay supplement if the National Agenda for Change hourly rate falls below this. To be responsible for inputting, maintaining and retrieval of information from relevant databases Attend to team and personal email inbox correspondence appropriately. Liaise with all staff in department to ensure systems and process are up to date and in line with Team requirements. Make or change appointments on behalf of the Team and ensure that relevant documentation is available. Ensure that efficient communications between the Team and other relevant agencies are maintained. Compose routine/non-routine documents when necessary. Maintain regular contact with the Team throughout the day when necessary. Exercise independent judgement and initiative based on acquired knowledge if problems arise. Attend meetings and produce minutes and agendas. Establish good levels of communication/liaison with departments and other services. Make full use of information technology and co-operative in the introduction of technological developments. The ability to work as a team member Undertake general office duties that fall in line with a team operating both in person and digitally. Update and maintain tracking systems used by the team Please download a copy of the job description (see documents to download section below) for full details of the main responsibilities for this role. At CWP, our recruitment selection processes are based on both competence (see person specification for details) and values. CWP recruits people that can demonstrate the Trusts Values in their everyday life and we use a values-based approach in our interviews, which explores not only what you do but how and why you do it. Before applying, we encourage you to review the Trusts Values and think about how these align with your own personal values. The supporting information section in your application should reflect your understanding of the Trusts Values and associated behaviours and you should provide examples from your work experience and/or personal life which demonstrate these values through your behaviours. An applicant guide to help and support you through your recruitment journey can be accessed at the bottom of this page. Further help and support for completing your application can be accessed via our website. If you need any further guidance to help you complete your application, contact our recruitment team via email at: cwp.recruitment@nhs.net or by calling 01244 393100. If you have a disability that meets the definition set out in the Equality Act 2010, and you can show that you meet the essential criteria described in the person specification for an available position, please answer YES to the question: Do you wish to be considered under the Guaranteed Interview Scheme? Please inform the team if you have any special support needs to be considered as part of the interview and selection processes. The trust offers a Guaranteed Interview Scheme to any armed forces community applicants who meet the essential criteria for the post and encourages applications from armed forces reservists or cadet force adult volunteers. Please note applicants will be required to pay for their DBS check. Costs are deducted from salary following appointment. You are encouraged to enrol for the DBS Update Service. A small annual fee of £16 per year applies. New entrants to the NHS will commence on the minimum of the scale stated above. Applicants are advised to apply early as if a large number of applications are received for this post we reserve the right to close the vacancy prior to the advertised date. Good luck with your application. We hope to welcome you to Team CWP very soon!
